values.note: A Loop (13 sites) is tent and van camping only; RVs go in B Loop (20 sites, recreation.gov permits RVs to 30 ft), where B-19, 21, 28, 29, 30 and 32 are pull-throughs. Two group sites besides. Up to 2 vehicles and 8 people a site.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/bank-campground ('This 33-site campground was recently renovated and has 31 individual sites, 2 group sites, and 4 vault toilets. Individual sites are limited to 2 vehicles and 8 people.'; 'Many sites are designed for tent or van camping. Large camp trailers and RVs that can manage the steep access road are accommodated with some pull-through sites in B-Loop.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274414 (notice 'A Loop sites are designed to accommodate tents or van camping'; 'Most B-Loop campsites are large enough to accommodate large trailer units and RVs (B-19, B21, B28, B29, B30, B32 are pull through sites).') + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:274414 (A-1 to A-13 tent only; B-14 to B-33 permitted RV 30, Caravan/Camper Van 15; Group Site 1 and 2), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No trash service; bring water and firewood and pack out trash.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/bank-campground ('4 vault toilets'; 'Drinking water, electric hook-ups and trash service are not available at The Bank Campground so please bring your own water and plan to take your trash with you when you leave. Bring your own firewood.'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/bank-campground ('Drinking water, electric hook-ups and trash service are not available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274414 (notice 'There are no hookup services'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Open year-round; June-August heat and pinyon gnats can make camping unpleasant (recreation.gov).

season.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/bank-campground ('Open year-round') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274414 (notice 'During the months of June, July and August, the extreme heat and the presence of pinyon gnats, flies, ants and other insects, can make camping during these months unpleasant.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: B Loop and the group sites are reservable on recreation.gov; a B Loop site not reserved for that day can be taken first come at the pay station, one night only. A Loop is first come, first served (pay at the station on arrival).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274414 (notices 'Campsites in A Loop are First Come, First Serve, Pay for the site at the pay station immediately after occupying the site.'; 'B Loop is Reservable 14 days in advance, if there isn't a current reservation on the day of, sites are available on a First Come, First Serve basis payable at the Pay Station for one night only.'; 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days.') + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:274414 (B-14 to B-33 and both group sites reservable), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Individual sites $20 a night, group sites $40 (2026-2028 rate tables). An $8 non-refundable reservation fee per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/bank-campground ('Individual Sites: $20 per night | Group sites: $40 per night | There is an $8 non-refundable reservation fee for each reservation.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/274414/rates (PeakStandardSite $20, PeakGroupSite $40, 2026-2028), read 2026-10-28

note: BLM (Royal Gorge Field Office) campground in the Shelf Road climbing area ~15 mi north of Canon City at ~6,900 ft, on a pinyon-juniper bench above Fourmile Creek's canyon, by the Cactus Cliff and Dark Side climbing trails. From US-50 take Dozier Ave and Field Ave north onto CR 9 (Shelf Road) about 10 mi, then ~1 mi up a steep, rough dirt spur that BLM does not recommend for large RVs and trailers. Come from the Canon City end; the upper (Cripple Creek) end of Shelf Road is narrow and steep and not recommended for trailers or motorhomes. --Claude
summary: BLM page + recreation.gov (274414) + catalog: confirmed no hookups, no water, $20, reservable, 14-night limit. Changed count 20->33 (A-1 to A-13 tent-only + B-14 to B-33; BLM says 33 sites). Added max 30 ft (catalog permitted RV length, B Loop), pull-throughs, vault toilets, year-round season, booking split (B Loop reservable, A Loop first come), $8 reservation fee. Note rewritten: the 'length unconfirmed' caveat is answered.
flags: Phone 719-269-8500 confirmed (BLM Royal Gorge Field Office: BLM page and recreation.gov).
Website: stored recreation.gov link works; the BLM page https://www.blm.gov/visit/bank-campground is the agency's own and could replace it.

Count: BLM says 'This 33-site campground ... has 31 individual sites, 2 group sites'; recreation.gov's catalog has 33 numbered individual sites (A-1 to A-13 tent only, B-14 to B-33 RV) plus Group Site 1 and 2. Recorded 33. Only the 20 B-Loop sites take an RV.
Length: BLM gives no figure. The catalog permits RVs to 30 ft at every B-Loop site (camper vans to 15 ft); no driveway lengths. Recorded 30. Over 23 ft, so no length criteria problem.

ACCESS WARNING (big-rig, not 4WD): BLM 'The dirt road leading to the campground is very rough and not recommended for large RVs and travel trailers' and 'The dirt road leading to The Bank campground is steep and rough'; recreation.gov 'The dirt road leading to the campground is steep and rough, please travel with caution. Large trailers and RVs are not advised.' The rough stretch is the ~1 mi spur off CR 9 (BLM: 'Campground is located approximately 1 mile up the rough dirt road'). But BLM also says 'Large camp trailers and RVs that can manage the steep access road are accommodated with some pull-through sites in B-Loop'. No 4WD wording. Whether a 23-ft Class C counts as 'large' is AWH's call.

Shelf Road approaches: BLM's directions use the Canon City end (Dozier Ave / Field Ave / CR 9 north ~10 mi). Gold Belt Byway FAQ: 'The upper portion of Shelf Road is not recommended for trailers, campers, or motor homes due to winding sections, narrow passages, and steep grades', and it 'narrow[s] to one lane in many places'. The Bank sits at the lower (Canon City) end, so the shelf section need not be driven. No current BLM alert or closure found for Shelf Road or the campground.

Booking: the notice says 'B Loop is Reservable 14 days in advance', but the facility rules give a 30-day reservationWindow (groups 3 months); window left unrecorded. reservationCutOff reads '3 / Not Reservable'; not recorded (same-day first-come use of unreserved B sites per the notice).
Pin 38.627976,-105.225243 (= recreation.gov facility point) sits on the B-Loop road by B-17/B-33, 113 m from the catalog centroid, 22 m from the nearest site. OK.

Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: Fourmile Creek runs in a deep, wooded canyon below the bench to the NE; the nearest sites (A-1 to A-4) are ~40-60 m from the rim with the creek tens of metres below and small. Not water at the sites.
